title: 1993-94 Upper Deck Chris Webber #483 Top Prospects RC Golden State Warriors
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1993-94 Upper Deck Chris Webber #483 Top Prospects rookie card featuring the player during his time with the Golden State Warriors in the NBA. This original sports trading card is manufactured by Upper Deck in the United States and is part of the base set for the 1993-94 season. The card is made of standard card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. It is a valuable collectible for fans of basketball and sports trading cards, especially for those interested in rookie cards and iconic players like Chris Webber.
